answer: Rotating Quartz Beacon. Each epoch a verifiable random beacon picks a small committee from registered agents; committee seats are assigned only after the beacon output is fixed, so attackers cannot target seats in advance. To register, an agent must solve a challenge keyed to the next beacon and deposit into a vault a fee refunded only after surviving a random audit. Sybil farms must fund many identities that the raven beacon may scatter across committees, and each failed audit forfeits that identity's deposit, making mass registration costly without precomputable advantage.
